title: Kirby Problem 1.18
exact_target: Relate meridional generators and bridges, determine what finite quotients and epimorphisms detect, and test freeness of small meridional subgroups of hyperbolic knot groups.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2677 (KP-1.18). CC BY 4.0.
R. \.{I}nan\c{c} Baykur, Robion C. Kirby and Daniel Ruberman, K3 -- A New Problem List in Low-Dimensional Topology, author preliminary edition (2026), Problem 1.18 and its remarks.
